data.body:
[P2] Preserve admission normalization through reporting

A valid SDK-owned manifest containing `native_concurrency: 2.0` is accepted and normalized only in this private copy. The public API returns just results, so the documented next step, `build_report(manifest, results, suite=suite)`, still receives `2.0`. Because `CaseRequirement.matches()` requires `type(concurrency) is int`, a successful case becomes `UNCOVERED` and produces exit code 1. Normalize a copy of the manifest during reporting, or expose the admitted snapshot for callers to report against. Add a public collection-to-report regression test using integral floating-point concurrency values.
